grammar.title: Present Perfect + For / Since
rules: "for" indica duração (quanto tempo): for two years, for six months.
"since" indica o ponto de início (desde quando): since 2022, since January.
Present perfect (have/has + V3) conecta o passado ao presente, mostrando que a ação continua: I've been freelancing for two years.
Com ações contínuas usa-se "have/has been + V-ing": She has been managing clients since January.
